name: Molecule
definition: A chemical compound record in the toxicology dataset, identified by a molecule_id of the form TR followed by three digits (e.g. TR060). A molecule is the top-level entity to which atoms, bonds and a carcinogenicity label belong.
scope: All molecule-level analysis: identifying a compound, counting its atoms or bonds, and reading its carcinogenicity classification.

name: Molecule Identifier Reference
definition: The TRnnn molecule key as it is carried by structure records. It appears as molecule.molecule_id, is repeated on atom.molecule_id and bond.molecule_id, and is embedded as the leading TRnnn segment of atom_id and bond_id values.
scope: Linking atoms and bonds back to their owning molecule, and deriving a molecule key from a structural identifier.

name: Carcinogenicity Label
definition: The classification attribute carried by a molecule record that states whether the compound is carcinogenic. It is stored as a single-character code.
scope: Any question that filters, counts or reports compounds by carcinogenicity.

name: Carcinogenic Molecule
definition: The subset of molecules whose carcinogenicity label marks them as carcinogenic (positive label). These compounds are the ones described as carcinogenic, cancerous or toxic-positive in analytical questions.
scope: Filtering or scoping analysis to cancer-causing compounds only.

name: Non-Carcinogenic Molecule
definition: The subset of molecules whose carcinogenicity label marks them as not carcinogenic (negative label).
scope: Filtering or scoping analysis to compounds that are not cancer-causing.

name: Atom
definition: An atom belonging to a molecule, identified by an atom_id composed of the owning molecule identifier, an underscore, and a within-molecule atom number (e.g. TR060_19). Each atom carries exactly one chemical element.
scope: Atom-level analysis: locating an atom inside a molecule, reading its element, and counting atoms per molecule.

name: Atom Number Within Molecule
definition: The integer position of an atom inside its own molecule, encoded as the numeric suffix of atom_id. Numbering restarts at 1 for every molecule and is not zero-padded, so the position and the character offset within atom_id are different things.
scope: Questions referring to the nth atom, the first/last atom, or a specific atom position of every molecule.

name: Chemical Element
definition: The chemical element of an atom, recorded as a lower-case chemical symbol code (for example c for carbon, h for hydrogen, cl for chlorine).
scope: Element composition analysis, tallying elements across atoms or across bonds.

name: Bond
definition: A chemical bond in a molecule, identified by a bond_id of the form molecule identifier plus the numbers of the two atoms it joins (e.g. TR004_8_9). Each bond belongs to exactly one molecule and has exactly one bond type.
scope: Bond-level analysis: locating a bond, counting bonds per molecule, and reading its bond type.

name: Bond Type
definition: The bond order of a bond, recorded as a single-character code that distinguishes single, double and triple bonds.
scope: Any question that filters, counts or compares bonds by bond order, including molecular bond-type distributions.

name: Single Bond
definition: The subset of bonds whose bond type is the single-bond code. Single bonds are the most common bond order in this dataset.
scope: Analysis restricted to single-bonded atoms or molecules.

name: Double Bond
definition: The subset of bonds whose bond type is the double-bond code. A molecule described as a double-bond molecule is a molecule that contains at least one such bond.
scope: Analysis restricted to double-bonded atoms or to molecules containing at least one double bond.

name: Triple Bond
definition: The subset of bonds whose bond type is the triple-bond code. It is the rarest bond order in this dataset, occurring in only a handful of bonds.

name: Atom-Bond Connection
definition: The incidence of an atom in a bond: one atom participating at one end of one bond. This is what analytical questions call the connections or bonds of an atom. Each bond generates exactly two such incidences, one per participating atom.
scope: Counting or listing the bonds that involve a given atom, and resolving which atoms a bond joins.

name: Unbonded Atom
definition: The subset of atoms that participate in no bond at all. Such atoms never appear in the atom-bond connection records in either atom position.
scope: Identifying atoms that cannot bond with any other atom, and reporting their elements.

name: Molecule Atom Count
definition: The number of atoms that belong to a molecule, obtained by counting the atoms grouped by their owning molecule. It expresses molecular size and is the quantity compared in questions about molecules that consist of more than a given number of atoms.
scope: Molecular size comparison and filtering molecules by atom count.

name: Bond Type Share
definition: The proportion of bonds of one bond type among a defined set of bonds, expressed as the count of bonds of that type divided by the total count of bonds in the same set. Reported as a percentage, the value is that proportion scaled by one hundred.
scope: Questions asking what percentage or fraction of bonds in a molecule, or in the whole dataset, is of a given bond type.

name: Element Share
definition: The proportion of atoms of one element among a defined set of atoms, expressed as the count of atoms of that element divided by the total count of atoms in the same set. Questions phrased as the percentage of carbon, or the average number of an element per bond, refer to this ratio.
scope: Questions asking what percentage or average proportion of atoms in a molecule, bond or molecule group is of a given element.

name: Majority Bond Type
definition: The bond type that occurs most often within a defined set of bonds, that is the bond type accounting for the largest number of bonds in that set.
scope: Questions asking which bond type accounts for the majority of the bonds of a molecule or of a bond group.
